description: NaSbP₂S₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to seven S atoms to form distorted NaS₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaS₇ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent PPS₃ tetrahedra, edges with three equivalent NaS₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one PPS₃ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 3.06-3.19 Å. Sb is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six S atoms. There are a spread of Sb-S bond distances ranging from 2.62-3.07 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one P and three S atoms. The P-P bond length is 2.26 Å. There are a spread of P-S bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.07 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to one P and three S atoms to form distorted PPS₃ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₇ pentagonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one SNa₂SbP tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaS₇ pentagonal bipyramid. There are a spread of P-S bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.08 Å. There are six inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Sb, and one P atom. In the second S site, S is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Sb, and one P atom to form distorted SNa₂SbP tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one PPS₃ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent SNa₂SbP tetrahedra. In the third S site, S is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Sb and one P atom. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to three equivalent Na and one P atom. In the fifth S site, S is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Sb, and one P atom. In the sixth S site, S is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to one Sb and one P atom.
